description: Poly Volume: Polymarket activity screen — ranks markets by turnover (24h volume over resting liquidity) and reports round-trip cost, so you can tell a busy market from a merely large one. Filter with minVolumeUsd and maxSpreadBps. count is how many cleared the filters; returnedMarkets and marketsTruncated describe the page (upstream reads the top 60 by 24h volume). Use x402-poly-markets for a plain list.
name: x402-poly-volume
